Basic Movement & Key Presses
What is Pygame?
Pygame is a third party module designed for creating 2D games with python. It has very simple and intuitive syntax that can allows us to create powerful games quickly. Pygame uses surfaces for drawing. This means whenever we want to draw something to the screen it must be converted to a surface. There are many methods and functions within pygame that can do this easily for us.
Installing Pygame
Installing pygame can be as easy as:
Opening your command prompt Typing pip install pygame

In many games we need to check for different types of collision. Whether that be collision of our mouse with a button or collision between images and/or objects. In our case we want to check if our goblin has hit the player or if our bullets have hit the goblin.
Hit Boxes
The term "hit box" is often used to represent the box around an object which represents its "hittable space". Basic Movement & Key Presses
What is Pygame?
Pygame is a third party module designed for creating 2D games with python. It has very simple and intuitive syntax that can allows us to create powerful games quickly. Pygame uses surfaces for drawing. This means whenever we want to draw something to the screen it must be converted to a surface. There are many methods and functions within pygame that can do this easily for us.

candidates.description: 课程中文标题：Streamlit与Python：构建与部署真实世界数据应用 课程英文标题：Streamlit with Python: Build and Deploy Real-World Data Apps 课程时长：16小时22分钟 核心技术：Streamlit、Python、数据可视化、数据库与API集成、云部署 行业应用：数据分析与可视化、机器学习模型部署、商业智能仪表盘、内部工具开发 一、课程核心模块与技术亮点 1. Streamlit核心机制与快速开发 • 深入解析Streamlit无前端代码、脚本即应用的执行模型，理解其“用户交互触发脚本重运行”的核心机制。 • 强调极速开发特性，学员无需HTML/CSS/JavaScript知识，仅用Python脚本即可构建完整交互式Web应用。 2. 交互式UI构建与数据可视化实战 • 系统教授丰富UI组件（按钮、滑块、表单、数据表格编辑器）的使用与布局控制。 • 集成主流数据可视化库（Matplotlib、Seaborn、Plotly、Altair），教授如何根据数据场景选择并创建交互式图表。 3. 应用状态管理与性能优化 • 重点讲解st.session_state用于管理用户会话数据，实现复杂交互逻辑。 • 教授缓存（st.cache_data, st.cache_resource）技术，优化数据加载与计算密集型任务性能，构建响应迅速的生产级应用。 4. 高级应用架构与集成 • 构建多页面应用程序，实现清晰的项目结构与跨
